metadata.comparison: cooperative minus H transform: negative time/fuel means cooperative is lower
metadata.interpretation: A benefit shared by cooperative-only does not establish that formed platoons caused it. H-minus-C0 is the formation/fill policy contrast, including its ordinary-overtake policy difference.
